highlights: Project-scoped Repository Command Center backend with typed Git and GitHub operations
Isolated agent branch and worktree leases with backend policy enforcement
Durable approvals, operation recovery, remote projections, and merge-readiness evaluation
Project-scoped Swarms with durable missions, role sessions, tasks, evidence, and review state
fixes: Reject stale pushes, merges, approvals, and queued mutations after repository state changes
Bound and redact Git and GitHub process output while preserving user hooks, signing, SSH, LFS, and credential helpers
Prevent agent mutations outside the assigned Project, branch, worktree, task, and file scope
Prevent Swarm creation, execution, memory access, worktree reuse, and evidence association outside the owning Project
databaseChanges: Add forward-only schema 13 for repository connections, policies, worktree leases, operations, approvals, remote cache, synchronization cursors, webhook deduplication, and recovery checkpoints
Add forward-only schemas 14 and 15 for durable Swarm orchestration and canonical Project ownership backfill
knownIssues: GitHub App installation-token exchange and public webhook ingress require the separately deployed Corelith backend service
Remote synchronization is explicit-refresh only; native repository watching and background event-relay synchronization are not included in schema 13
The GitHub CLI adapter is not yet extracted behind a runtime-pluggable provider trait, and PARALITH 0.2.0 has no OS notification service
Production update publication remains disabled until administrators provision the updater signing key and internal HTTPS endpoint
